newsitem.title: USA: Collagen to separate aesthetic medicine.
newsitem.headline: Collagen to separate aesthetic medicine.

text.p: Collagen Corp said it will separate Aesthetic Technologies Group, its profitable aesthetic and reconstructive surgery business, and form a new company.
Collagen's other operating group, Collagen Technologies, is focused on collagen-based research and product development programs and management and growth of its affiliate companies.

It is evaluating a public offering, a spin-off or a split-off of the firm, to be called Aesthetic Technologies Corp. Gary Petersmeyer was named president and chief executive officer. The new company will have its own Board of Directors.
